title: Security fixes, built (e9eecd0)
intro:
Your 12 answers are built and committed locally: harness **e9eecd0** (258 files) and ayepi **0c17846** (auth https-only endpoints; node socket limits). **Nothing is pushed.** Typecheck passes. The 11 key regression test files pass (134 tests); the full run was 846 of 855, and the failures were fixed, plus the known proxy.test one.

Each fix has an exploit-style test that fails without it. One verdict per item; the last items are the open questions.

**Needs your eyes in a browser:** the new CSP (index.html, PDFs, system client builds) and the web system's Chrome rendering. I only checked them by reading code.

items.title: Status of every finding
items.ask: Does the status list match what you expected?

items.title: Security passage in harness.md
items.ask: Is the new Security passage right?

items.title: H1: events per person
items.note: `ROUTES` now says who hears each event: notifications go to their person; approvals to approvers plus the turn user; session summaries to participants; pairings to admins. Shared catalog/system events still go to everyone signed in. Sign-out or turning a user off closes their sockets.

items.title: H5/H6: fs bash safe list
items.note: A table of allowed commands with refused flags. A path word must resolve inside the roots; `$`, `~` and globs ask. `echo`, `npm test`, `npx vitest` and `npx tsc` are off the list. Bash gets a scrubbed env plus the fs `commandEnv` allowlist.

items.title: New admin settings
items.md:
| Setting | Where | Default |
|---|---|---|
| Load outside images | Settings › Hub | ask |
| Password tries | People › Sign-in | 10 / 15 min per (email, address); 100 / 15 min per address |
| Proxy | People › Sign-in | 0 proxies (X-Forwarded-For ignored) |
| allowPrivate | each API service | off |

| commandEnv | fs config | none |
| snapshots | fs config | 20 per file, 500 MB |

items.title: Open: limits that are still env settings
items.md: Your note said conditional things should be admin settings. These ended up as **env settings** instead: pairing limits (`HARNESS_PAIRING_*`), socket caps (`HARNESS_LINK_*`), max frame (`HARNESS_MAX_FRAME`, now 4 MiB), WS message size, and fs grep's timeout and line cap (`FS_*`).
items.ask: Looks good = move them to admin settings (I recommend this for pairing limits; frame and socket sizes are read at start, so they can stay env). No = leave all as env.

items.title: Open: smaller gaps left
items.md:
- **Unshared api services:** still visible (name and base URL) through the hub's generic record tools.
- **Removal from a session:** someone removed keeps an open `on.session` subscription until their socket closes.
- **Git config already in a repo:** a `textconv`/`filter` there still runs on a typed `git diff`.
- **Approvers lookup:** `StoreApprovers.#admins` still loads every user and filters in memory (`activeAdmins` can replace it).
- **Per-process state:** SSO hand-off codes and the setup code are held in memory, per process.
- **IPv6 ranges:** the address guard doesn't block the NAT64 or 6to4 ranges.
- **Low findings not chosen:** email auto-linking to the break-glass admin, systems labelling their own fns, the database dry-run running DML, the JS network guard being advisory only, public client builds and docs, and the WS token in the URL.
items.ask: Looks good = I fix the first six in a follow-up. Needs changes = say which.
